name: pessimism
quote: There's no way we're going to win.
description: A sense that a desired outcome is so unlikely as to be impossible.
perceptions: An outcome I prefer is not a real possibility.

guidance.description: It’s common for people to focus on the negative elements of a situation first, before considering potentially positive aspects. Our minds are designed to identify potential dangers and pitfalls, but when you’re always looking at the worst-case scenario, that innate skepticism can harden into cynicism and a bleak outlook that is hard to lose. However, the mind can be trained to see things from a more optimistic point of view, and learning how to see the glass as half full rather than half empty can have lasting benefits.
Why We Find Pessimists to be More Intelligent -- By seeming rather oblivious to risks that a pessimist would hurry to point out, optimists can end up looking less intelligent by default.

variations.name: pessimistic mindset
variations.description: A general pattern of negative predictions -- that most things will turn out bad.
perceptions: I can't trust in most outcomes I want.
Things generally turn out poor in the end.

commentaries.quote: A pessimist sees the difficulty in every opportunity; an optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
The pessimist complains about the wind; the optimist expects it to change; the realist adjusts the sails.
The nice part about being a pessimist is that you are constantly being either proven right or pleasantly surprised.
